C-OPENCODE-MODULE-SPLIT.IntentSummary: Replace the 2045-line src/lib/opencode.ts god-module with a concern-scoped src/lib/opencode/ directory whose index.ts barrel re-exports the complete previous public API, then reconcile M-CLI-CONFIG durable projections. Pure structural move: no behavior, public API, schema, or package surface change. Approved by explicit user instruction formalizing the reviewed refactoring list; execution has not started.

PlanningNotes.Note: Approval provenance: the user explicitly instructed autonomous formalization of the five reviewed refactoring items; this bundle is item 1 of that list. The plan was produced together with the spec under that instruction and no implementation has started.

Coordinated execution order for the four refactor bundles created in the same session: C-OPENCODE-MODULE-SPLIT, then C-WORKFLOW-INDEX-REDUCE, then C-SPEC-LINT-RULES-SPLIT, then C-TEST-PLACEMENT-CONVENTION last, because the last one renames test file paths that the earlier bundles' baseline and target commands reference. Execute and archive one bundle before starting the next.

Move zones map to the spec constraints: paths.ts takes START_BLOCK_RESOLVE_CONFIG_PATHS plus Scope/ResolvedPaths; plugin-registration.ts takes package/TUI pinning, plugin-list normalization, and the pinned-specifier constants; agent-registrations.ts takes managed agent registrations, prompts, skills, symlink, and managed model IO; model-overrides.ts takes generic agent/default model and provider object/baseURL overrides; vvoc-config-io.ts takes canonical vvoc.json read/install/sync and guardian writes; inspection.ts takes runtime version/compatibility, installation inspection, and describeWriteResult; shared-utils.ts takes the trailing JSON-value, render, text, and filesystem private helpers. Constants stay with the zone that owns them and are re-exported by the barrel only if the old file exported them.

Each new file gets a full file-local MODULE_CONTRACT, MODULE_MAP, block anchors carried over from the moved code, and a START_CHANGE_SUMMARY crediting C-OPENCODE-MODULE-SPLIT. Private helpers are imported from shared-utils.ts, never duplicated. No export may be dropped: the barrel plus zone files must satisfy the unmodified src/lib/opencode.test.ts imports and bun run typecheck across all 18 consumers.

M-CLI-CONFIG stays the single owning module: replace src/lib/opencode.ts in its Paths with the new files; Purpose, Depends, and Verification stay unchanged. V-M-CLI-CONFIG command paths reference src/lib/opencode.test.ts, which keeps its path, so verification entries need only reconciliation review, not new scenarios.

No final-review obligation is declared: this is a behavior-preserving move whose evidence is the unmodified full opencode test suite, check, build, and pack:check through the barrel. Any reviewer the controller independently requests is optional, not a gate recorded here.
GRACE lifecycle commands are external execution gates, never nested MustPassCommand values. The test ! -f leaf command is file-shape evidence, not a lifecycle command.

T-001.Title: Split opencode.ts into concern-scoped zone files behind an API-preserving barrel.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Create src/lib/opencode/ with paths.ts, plugin-registration.ts, agent-registrations.ts, model-overrides.ts, vvoc-config-io.ts, inspection.ts, and shared-utils.ts, moving the current implementation into exactly one owning zone file per function, constant, and type, preserving export names, signatures, error text, and behavior. Carry START_BLOCK_* anchors over with their code.

Create src/lib/opencode/index.ts as a re-export-only barrel of the complete previous public API of src/lib/opencode.ts, then delete src/lib/opencode.ts. The specifiers ../lib/opencode.js and ./opencode.js must resolve for every existing consumer, including src/lib/opencode.test.ts.
Give every new file a truthful MODULE_CONTRACT linking M-CLI-CONFIG, a MODULE_MAP, and a START_CHANGE_SUMMARY crediting this change. Private helpers live once in shared-utils.ts.
src/lib/opencode.test.ts passes unmodified; bun run typecheck passes across all consumers; no public export is added, removed, renamed, or retyped.
